TOPIC: Ожидание

TOPIC_DESCRIPTION: Situation: You arrive for a job interview on Friday and first speak to the receptionist before meeting the interviewer. This is a short check-in that gets you to the right place and makes the start less stressful before the main conversation about your background.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: talking about work experience, answering questions about skills, discussing schedule or salary.

About the learner, in their own words: Собеседование в пятницу, боюсь вопросов про опыт

1. give your name — slot: the name
2. say why you are here — slot: the position
3. answer whether you have been here before — slot: the last visit (never, once)
4. ask how long the interview will take — slot: none
5. ask where to wait — slot: none
6. confirm you are ready to begin — slot: none
must_understand:
1. asks for your name and what position you are here for
2. asks whether this is your first time here
3. says the interviewer will see you soon
4. tells you where to wait
5. asks whether you are ready to start
